item.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker
item.description:
Title: The Blood of Dawnwalker
Genre: Action , Adventure , RPG
Developer: Rebel Wolves
Publisher: Bandai Namco Entertainment
Franchise: Bandai Namco Entertainment
Release Date: Sep 2, 2026




About This Game

14th-century Europe. Bloody conflicts sweep the lands, and the Black Death comes for the survivors. It's a moment of weakness - and that's all they needed. Vampires seize their opportunity to walk out of the shadows and claim what they've been denied for centuries: freedom, and the power that comes with it. Other creatures of the night follow their lead. Legends turn into reality, and history as we know it will never be the same.

You play as Coen, a young man turned into a Dawnwalker, forever treading the line between the world of day and the realm of night. Fight for your humanity or embrace the cursed powers to save your family. Whatever your choice, the question stands: is your soul worth the lives of those you love?

Experience and shape the plot the way you want. Embark on the quest to save your family, or swear revenge on your sire and destroy everyone standing in your way. Discover ancient secrets lurking in the valley. Rush in head first or risk taking time to prepare. Go alone or search for friends and forge unlikely alliances.

Experience two different gameplay loops, offering distinct abilities to choose from, mysteries to uncover, and varying ways to achieve your goals. Experiment with different approaches and discover how the world reacts to your actions.

Every action - and inaction - shapes the world around you. Your family’s days are numbered, and every time you take on a quest, time moves forward, compelling you closer to the end. Choose carefully whom to help and whom to leave behind. You will not have time for everyone. The world waits for no one. And neither does the villain.

Defy gravity, become a brutal force of nature, and use your supernatural skills as a vampire. Or raise your sword, and employ powerful magic to take on opponents as a human. Experiment and adapt as your form changes during the day and night; each has its strengths and weaknesses.

Venture through the hand-crafted open world and discover all it has to offer. Roam through the lush forests, the vast plains, the treacherous swamps, the steep mountaintops, and the medieval settlements. Explore forgotten ruins, find remnants of an ancient civilization, and uncover truths that should probably remain hidden.

Experience the beginning of a brand-new saga built with love for the role-playing genre. Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world powered by the next-gen Unreal Engine 5.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Some Nudity or Sexual Content, Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10, DirectX12
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400F / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 60 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: VRAM: 6GB // Storage on SSD
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10, DirectX12
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5700X
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 / Radeon RX 7600 XT / Intel Arc B580
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 60 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: VRAM: 8GB // Storage on SSD

item.title: Tyr
item.description:
Title: Tyr
Genre: Action , Indie , Strategy , Free To Play , Early Access
Developer: Stoke Games
Publisher: Stoke Games
Release Date: Sep 2, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 2, 2026




About This Game

This is Tyr, a tank shooter where positioning, strategic decision-making, and mastery of unique abilities win.

TANKS

Tyr features a roster of specialized armored vehicles and pilots. You’ll take control of treaded and hover tanks alike as you angle & position for defense, and rumble and glide across the battlefield.

CUSTOMIZATION

Each vehicle also offers its own tech tree and ammo & component slots, affording you the ability to upgrade and evolve your ride to suit your playstyle. You may even be able to change up your vehicle’s unique keystone tech to dynamically alter your personal meta.

ABILITIES

Each vehicle features a unique power that impacts Tyr’s moment-to-moment play on the battlefield. A tank may have the ability to blink several vehicle lengths forward or back, send out a sonar pulse to spot enemies, or overcharge its engine to ram directly into an opponent and deal massive damage.

ASYMMETRIC VISION

In Tyr, you and your opponents will only be visible when within range or while making enough noise. Deciding when to push forward and when to fire from cover could mean the difference between staying hidden and revealing your position to the entire enemy team, so play carefully.

STRATEGY

Tyr will test your mental mettle, patience, and teamwork, as deliberate play beats whoever can fire the fastest.

FEATURES

  • Multiplayer tank shooter - Engage in strategic team battles with heavy-armored vehicles

  • A roster of heavy armor - Tanks in Tyr each feature a unique armor profile that you can angle and position to deflect enemy shots in the heat of battle

  • Vehicle customization - Individual tech trees, ammo slots, and component upgrades for each tank

  • Keystone tech variations - Max level your tank to unlock meta-changing tech

  • Asymmetric vision - Position yourself correctly, and you’ll see the enemy and spot them for your team, while the enemy can't see you in return

  • Unique vehicle abilities - Each tank has a distinct ability that makes moment-to-moment play more high-stakes and interesting

  • Strategy beats twitch reflexes - Run and gun gameplay gets punished by careful positioning and slow, deliberately placed shots to disable enemies

item.title: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
item.description:
Title: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Yolo Games Studio
Publisher: Yolo Games Studio
Release Date: Sep 2, 2026




About This Game

Get the Stores Ready for Opening

Megastore: Tidy Up Together is a cozy organization game about transforming messy stores into clean, carefully arranged shopping spaces, either solo or together in online co-op.

Products are scattered throughout each store, and every item belongs in a specific department, category, and shelf. Follow the signs, identify where each product belongs, group matching items together, and place everything in its correct location before the store opens.

Work together, divide the store between your team, develop an organization strategy, and gradually bring order to thousands of products.

Three Stores Available at Launch

The game launches with three fully playable stores of increasing scale, each offering a different organization challenge and atmosphere.

  • The Toy Store: Begin your journey in a smaller and cozier single-story store filled with colorful toys and summer essentials. Sort 3,555 items and place them across 297 shelves while learning how to identify, group, and organize each product.

  • The Supermarket: Tidy up a bustling supermarket packed with fresh favorites and everyday essentials. Organize 7,934 products across 487 shelves and prepare every aisle and fresh-food counter for opening.

  • The Megastore: Take on the ultimate challenge in a massive two-story megastore containing 13,380 items across nine departments and 978 shelves. Organize the entire building and restore order to the largest store available at launch. Playable solo, but co-op is recommended.

Play through all three launch stores solo or cooperatively, choose the difficulty that suits you, split responsibilities between players, focus on different departments, or work together shelf by shelf.

Sort, Group, and Shelve

Organizing each store requires more than simply picking products up from the floor.

Pay attention to department signs, recognize product categories, group similar items together, and determine which shelf is appropriate for each product. As the empty shelves begin to fill and the store gradually takes shape, every correctly placed item brings you one step closer to opening.

With more than 1,114 unique products and 53 different shelf types , the store contains a huge variety of items to identify and organize.

Develop Your Own Strategy

Progress through the skill tree and unlock abilities that increase the pace of the cleanup.

Improve your movement and organization capabilities, choose upgrades that suit your preferred playstyle, and decide how your team will approach each store. The skills you prioritize can shape your strategy and help you complete increasingly large sections of the store more efficiently.

Whether you focus on speed, carrying capacity, or other useful improvements, each upgrade helps you work through the store faster.

Coming Soon After Launch

Two additional stores are already in active development and are planned to arrive through early post-launch updates, expanding the game from three launch stores to five. They are not included in the launch version, but we aim to make them available soon after release.

Custom Levels Coming in a Major Update

Custom level creation and sharing are also in active development and planned as one of the game's first major post-launch updates. This feature is not included in the launch version.

Players will be able to design their own organization challenges, share them with the community, and play custom levels together in co-op. Development is already underway, and more details will be shared as the update gets closer to release.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

AI tools were used to assist with some of the game’s translations and in the creation of two in-game textures. These textures were subsequently edited, refined, and carefully reviewed by a human before being included in the final game.

We strictly rely on human creativity and craftsmanship throughout the game’s development.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
    • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050ti
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 8 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
    • Processor: i5 7600K / Ryzen 5 2600x
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 3GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 8 GB available space

item.title: He Who Watches
item.description:
Title: He Who Watches
Genre: Adventure , Indie
Developer: Bobby Vanden
Publisher: Draknek and Friends
Release Date: Sep 2, 2026




About This Game

He Who Watches is an atmospheric first-person puzzle game that tasks you with navigating a seemingly impossible structure. Grapple with spatial reasoning and shifts in perspective to solve mind-bending puzzle chambers in a mysterious puzzle-platformer where every surface is a possible pathway.

Your bow is not a weapon, but a puzzle-solving tool used to manipulate your environment. Together with a single, magical arrow, you can open doors, move blocks, activate switches, and pull yourself across gaps with its magical chain.

Walk on walls. Walk on ceilings. Shift gravity as you slip between these planes, creating chain reactions to find the correct path forward. Patience and persistence are key to unlocking each solution.

What lies at the heart of this ancient labyrinth? How vast is this enigmatic structure? He Who Watches is full of secret paths, hidden mechanics, and cryptic symbols that invite you to look closer. Seek the imprisoned god at the centre. He is waiting.

  • Created by solo developer Bobby Vanden

  • Published by puzzle specialists Draknek & Friends

  • Solve over 100 handcrafted puzzles, each one more demanding than the last

  • Seek guidance when stuck, with a playable hint system

  • For the curious, investigate secrets that lurk in every nook and cranny

No generative AI was used in development.

System Requirements

Windows

item.title: ShipShaper: Falconeer Chronicles
item.description:
Title: ShipShaper: Falconeer Chronicles
Genre: Casual , Indie , Early Access
Developer: Tomas Sala
Publisher: Wired Productions , Gamersky Games
Franchise: The Falconeer
Release Date: Sep 2, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 2, 2026




About This Game

The joy of designing boats and ships, nothing more, nothing less.

I’ve always loved ships and boats, tall ships, steamers, pre-dreadnought french monstrosities, I love em all.
ShipShaper is a explorative ship builder I made for the simple pleasure of shaping boats and ships. You pull, push, and drag forms into place, creating everything from humble fishing vessels to tall ships, ironclads, and early dreadnoughts.
You can create historical ships, fantasy ships, steampunk you name it.

It's a boat designer married to experimental interfaces that are intended to take away the tedium from designing boats. No 3D skills required, no endless stacks of cubes, just some organic shaping and attaching props and functional items to create whatever ship you want.

When you’re done, you can place your ships into a world and sail them, the game does a proper analysis of your creation, its propulsion, hull shape and weight, all in order so you can properly enjoy and test your creation.

As an homage to my modding roots, I am also adding a 3D FBX e xport option, not just for 3D printing but also for modding and other indies. ShipShaper will come with a license to use the ships you create in any way you want for your own game development, 3d Printing, board games or modding venture.

ShipShaper is about creating a foundational technology that will power my own future games, connect my franchise but also empower other creators to have fun with ships and have a usable output, game-ready and usable.

Features:

  • Free-form building

  • Responsive shaping

  • Expanding library of details and props

  • Test your ship, get sailing behavior that is derived from your design.

  • Export FBX or STL 3d files with a license to use how you see fit.

  • Export to Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles

  • Export to Future sailing game under development

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10+, Linux Proton
    • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent AMD
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Intel Arc A380. or Nvidia GTX 1650 or AMD RX 6400 for 1080p60
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 11, Linux Proton
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent AMD
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: Nvidia RTX3080 or AMD RX 7800 XT for 4K60
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 2 GB available space
    • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
